anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: || papyrus page 17. ῑη = 18. Continues Witte p.108 / PDF 112. After this 5–7 L. ca. 23 Z.

bible_refs.note: Tenth to fourteenth; by houses; midst of the evenings.

choices.why: The numeral is in the papyrus; keep 18.

pass_a_gloss: And thus Hebrews do pascha: from the tenth one must take the sheep by houses and by families, and still feed them the eleventh and twelfth and thirteenth, and name saying: This sheep is sacrificed for this one and that one, they not exceeding 18 names, and on the fourteenth it is sacrificed in the midst of the evenings, so that from the taking of the sheep until the sacrificing there are five days. And this used to happen according to the sensible.
pass_b_english: [And] thus [the Hebrews keep Passover]: from the tenth one must [take] the sheep [by] houses and [by] families, [and] still [feed] them the eleventh and twelfth and thirteenth, [and] name them, saying: "This sheep is sacrificed for this one and that one" — their names not exceeding eighteen — and on the fourteenth it is sacrificed in the midst of the evenings. So from the taking of the sheep until the sacrificing there are five days. And this used to take place according to the sensible.
